bio: Ahoy there, I'm Missy, your friendly neighborhood b!mbocowclown! Thanks so much for stopping by and hangin' out with us here at TheB!mboFarm! Grab a seat, a blanket, and get nice and cozy with us as we hail Gregory and play lots of fun games!
